subject: Medixa Health DPIA — evidence runbook & sprint plan
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medixahealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Medixa Health Security Team <security@medixahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: DPIA for Redwood integration (Medixa)

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our privacy team has asked us to complete a DPIA for the planned integration (Medixa -> patient data flow to Redwood inference). I've attached our standard DPIA template (Medixa_DPIA_Template_2026.xlsx).

Could you confirm whether Redwood can provide an evidence runbook mapping the template rows to artifacts (logs, SOC 2 controls, data flow diagrams) and an estimated turnaround for the first pass? Our regulators want a response within two weeks if possible.

A few immediate asks from us:
- High-level data flow (export/import points, any PHI handling)
- Data retention and deletion controls for cached tokens/KV stores
- Copies of recent compliance artifacts (SOC 2 summary, DPA)

Appreciate your help — looping in our security team on CC.

Best,
Elena
Elena Rossi
DPO, Medixa Health
[attachment: Medixa_DPIA_Template_2026.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medixahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: DPIA for Redwood integration (Medixa)

Hi Elena — thanks for sending the template and for the clear asks. We're happy to support.

Proposed next steps from our side:
1) We'll produce an "evidence runbook" that maps each DPIA question to the recommended artifact (policy, SOC 2 section, log sample, DPA clause).
2) We'll include a short data-flow diagram and a short note on token caching/expiration and how PHI is handled in hosted vs dedicated deployments.
3) We'll attach a SOC 2 control summary and our standard DPA excerpt relevant to retention/SCCs.
4) Internal owners: Neha (security) will own the control mapping, Priyom (legal) will confirm contractual language, and I'll coordinate delivery and the timeline.

Do you have any specific sections of the template you want prioritized (e.g., sections relating to international transfers/SCCs or PHI processing)? We can aim to deliver a first-pass runbook within 7 business days.

I'll start creating a runbook CSV and drop a Drive link when it's ready.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Manager, Security & Privacy Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: DPIA for Redwood integration (Medixa)

Monica — quick mapping notes below for the runbook. I pulled the relevant artifacts from our compliance bucket.

- Data flows: we'll produce a 1-page diagram (fields: ingress point, preprocessing, inference, KV cache, egress) and call out encryption-at-rest TLS in transit.
- Retention: default hosted token cache TTL is 24 hours; dedicated installs can set TTL per customer. We'll document delete-on-request and DPA clauses.
- Logs: we can provide redacted log samples showing request/response timestamps and model version; logs contain no patient identifiers once tokenized, per our processing guidance (will list exact fields).
- International transfers/SCCs: our DPA includes SCCs and we maintain EU hosting in Azure regions; include link to SCC addendum.

Attachments for the runbook: redwood_soc2_summary_2025.pdf (control mappings), sample_redacted_logs.txt (log sample), data_flow_diagram.svg (diagram stub). I'll add owner annotations in the CSV.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
[attachment: sample_redacted_logs.txt (txt)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: DPIA for Redwood integration (Medixa)

Folks — a couple legal points to include in the runbook:
- Confirm whether Medixa will be considered a controller and Redwood a processor under the DPA (I believe controller = Medixa). We should state our processor obligations succinctly.
- Provide the exact DPA clauses for deletion, data subject rights support, and subprocessors.
- Timeline: we can commit to the 7-business-day first pass so long as external questions are limited to clarifications; any additional evidence pulls may require an extra 3–5 business days.

I'll review the runbook draft and prepare the contractual excerpts for inclusion.

Priyom
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medixahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 15:07:00 -0700
Subject: Medixa Health DPIA — evidence runbook & sprint plan

Elena — attaching our first-pass materials and proposed sprint schedule.

Summary deliverables (attached):
- Redwood_DPIA_Runbook_v1.csv — row-level mapping from Medixa template to Redwood artifacts and owners
- redwood_soc2_summary_2025.pdf — 1-page control summary (non-confidential)
- data_flow_diagram.svg (inline) — high-level flow for hosted vs dedicated

Key notes:
- First pass delivered within 7 business days as requested. See runbook column "owner" for the point of contact per question.
- Evidence items marked as "on request" will require an additional 3–5 business days for extraction or legal review (e.g., redacted log bundles, live environment snapshots).
- PHI handling: hosted mode uses tokenization and short TTL by default; dedicated deployments allow on-prem or VPC options and explicit contractual controls.
- SCCs/DPA: we've included the DPA excerpt relating to international transfers; for EU-hosted customers we operate within EU regions by default.

Next steps: please confirm which runbook rows to prioritize and whether you want us to prepare a formal DPIA memo for your legal team. We can also schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with Neha and Priyom.

Attachments: Redwood_DPIA_Runbook_v1.csv (csv), redwood_soc2_summary_2025.pdf (pdf), data_flow_diagram.svg (svg)

Best,
Monica Patel
Manager, Security & Privacy Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_DPIA_Runbook_v1.csv (csv)]
[attachment: redwood_soc2_summary_2025.pdf (pdf)]

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medixahealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Medixa Health Security Team <security@medixahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 21:42:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Medixa Health DPIA — evidence runbook & sprint plan

Monica — thank you, this is very helpful. We'll prioritize the rows related to PHI processing and SCCs. Two quick asks: 
1) Can you confirm whether the redacted log sample includes any patient identifiers (we need explicit confirmation that logs are tokenized/anonymized)?
2) Would you be able to add a short note in the runbook about retention exceptions (e.g., legal hold scenarios)?

Let's schedule the 30-minute walkthrough next week — Tue 10:00–10:30 AM CET works for our DPO and security lead. Please confirm attendees.

Best regards,
Elena
DPO, Medixa Health

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medixahealth.com>, Medixa Health Security Team <security@medixahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Jul 2026 07:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Medixa Health DPIA — evidence runbook & sprint plan

Elena — quick clarifications:
- Confirmation on logs: the sample we provided is redacted and contains NO direct patient identifiers. We'll add an explicit statement in the runbook CSV and attach an export-sample readme that documents fields removed.
- Retention exceptions: we'll add a "legal hold" row that describes our escalation path, the limited exception process, and the contractual notice period.

Attendees for the walkthrough (confirmed): Monica Patel (Redwood), Neha Kapoor (Redwood), Priyom Das (Redwood), Elena Rossi (Medixa DPO), James Lowe (Medixa Security Lead). I'll send a calendar invite for Tue 10:00–10:30 AM CET.

Thanks — will push an updated runbook and the readme first thing Monday.

Monica
